patterns.note: Full-bleed imagery and video are used extensively, often as background elements for text or as large-scale portfolio displays.
A strong typographic hierarchy is established by pairing a bold, elegant serif for display text with a clean, uppercase sans-serif for navigation and labels.
The primary color scheme relies on high contrast between black backgrounds and white text, punctuated by vibrant, saturated colors within the photography and video content.
As the user scrolls, distinct content sections are revealed, transitioning from a video hero to a full-screen typographic statement, and then to a dynamic split-screen layout.
A distinctive split-screen layout is used to present two complementary visual narratives or content blocks side-by-side, creating a dynamic visual balance.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background that plays on loop, establishing an immediate immersive and dynamic experience.
Content sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls, with each section occupying a full viewport height or significant portion, creating a distinct visual break and focus.
Large-scale, high-contrast typography is employed as a primary visual element, often set against dark, full-bleed backgrounds or overlaid on imagery to create impactful statements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold serif headings (~4-5x body text) for impact, contrasted with smaller, uppercase sans-serif navigation and labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (mostly rectangular images and sections, no visible rounded corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the grid has moderate padding, and large text sections utilize significant negative space for emphasis.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold, editorial aesthetic achieved through the dramatic interplay of large-scale, high-contrast typography and full-bleed, often vibrant, photography and video. The use of a dynamic split-screen layout further elevates its unique visual storytelling approach.
